.

mber can understand and maintain them)

title: Product Designer / Graphic Designer — Project-Based
description:
Who We Are



We're a fast-growing skincare brand running a 7-figure monthly revenue — and we're not slowing down. Our products are flying off shelves, and now we need the creative talent to match that 
ntum. We're looking for a skilled Product Designer / Graphic Designer for a project-based engagement to help shape how our brand looks, feels, and connects with customers.



What You'll Work On



Product packaging design (labels, boxes, inserts)

Brand graphics and visual assets

Social media creatives and campaign visuals

Product mockups and presentation materials

Full dieline creation including measurements and vectors

Any design collateral that brings our skincare line to life



What We're Looking For



Strong background in product design and/or graphic design — beauty, skincare, CPG, or consumer brands is a major plus

A sharp eye for aesthetics, typography, and clean, premium design

AI-forward designer — comfortable using AI tools to work smarter and faster without sacrificing quality

Ability to work from brand samples and guidelines to deliver on-brand results

Proficient in creating print-ready files, vectors, dielines, and technical specs

Experience with tools like Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, Figma, or equivalent

Self-directed, reliable, and communicates clearly



How This Works



This is a project-based role — there are no set hours and no fixed schedule. We move fast and expect you to as well. Our target turnaround is 2 to 3 days from the time the project kicks off. A deadline will be agreed upon at the start and we expect it to be met. We will provide product samples so you have everything you need to get started. Payment is released once the project is complete and we're satisfied with the output. Unlimited revisions are expected until the design is fully within brand standards — we want it right, not just done.



Non-Negotiable



Portfolio or proof of work is required to be considered. We don't care about your resume as much as we care about what you've actually made. No portfolio = no reply. Show us your best work, especially anything related to product packaging, beauty, wellness, or consumer goods.



How to Apply



Send your portfolio or proof of work to [your
 / application link] with the subject line: "Designer — [Your Name] — [Your Favorite Color]."

About Us



Enclave Med Spa is a growing medical aesthetic practice offering treatments including Botox, Dysport, Diamond Glow facials, and more. We're expanding fast and need a sharp, self-driven marketing VA who can own our digital presence and help us convert leads into booked patients — without being micromanaged.

 (Reels, carousels, stories, captions). Content should be on-brand, scroll-stopping, and written for a med spa audience.

 & SMS Campaigns — Build and send promotional campaigns in GHL to our patient list. Write copy for new patient offers (Botox, Dysport, Diamond Glow), manage the contact database, and maintain proper opt-out compliance.

 copy will represent Enclave Med Spa directly.

Stable, long-term position with a growing practice

Fully remote and flexible schedule

Work directly with ownership — no layers of management

Room to grow as we scale







How to Apply



Send the following to [your
 or application link]:

3 examples of social media content you created for a business

Your resume





Applications without a video will not be reviewed. This is how we know you're serious and that you can actually do the work.

mbers have the tools, training, and support needed to succeed.

Strong knowledge of GAAP and the Uniform System of Accounts for the Lodging Industry (USALI).

Proven ability to lead complex projects and cross-functional initiatives.

Advanced Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office skills.

title: Vendor Account Specialist
description:
Vendor Account Manager



Charlie’s Collectible Show (CCS)

Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 9 AM – 5 PM US Eastern Time (10PM - 6AM Philippines Time)

About Charlie’s Collectible Show



Charlie's Collectible Show (CCS) is a family-friendly hobby and collectibles marketplace currently running weekly events in Atlanta and Houston, with Raleigh launching this year and Orlando and Chicago planned next. We host anime markets, TCG conventions, retro gaming expos, artist alleys, and competitive tournaments — bringing collectors, vendors, artists, and fans of anime, gaming, and collectibles together under one roof. Every event has free entry and free parking.



CCS is built on community. We create spaces where fandom connects in real life, and our vendors are at the center of that. As a Vendor Coordinator, you are the primary point of contact for the Family Vendors who make each show happen — recruiting them, onboarding them, and supporting them week to week. Their success is the business, and your role is to keep that relationship strong.



Position Summary



The Vendor Billing & Accounts Specialist owns the money and the accuracy behind every CCS event. You manage vendor registration, invoicing, payment tracking, and event-readiness communication across multiple markets at once.



This is an operations and accounts role, not general admin. It directly impacts revenue, vendor trust, and whether each event runs clean. Your job is to make sure the right vendors are approved, every invoice is collected on time, no event is overbooked, and every vendor walks in on event day knowing exactly where to go and what to expect.



We're looking for someone who is precise with numbers, organized under pressure, and confident enough to hold a deadline with a vendor while keeping the relationship warm. That balance — firm on policy, generous in tone — is the actual skill this job is built on.



Core Responsibilities

 • Process a high volume of vendor sign-ups daily, managing registration and approvals while keeping accurate records (we use Notion; experience with it is a plus)

 • Oversee overall event booking across 5–8 events per month: track booking levels, flag events running low so the marketing team can get a promotional push, and monitor capacity closely to prevent overbooking.

 • Own vendor communication end to end — manage vendor inboxes and respond clearly, professionally, and on time.

 • Own the full vendor workflow from booking through event day: general communication, vendor prep support, load-in/load-out coordination, and building the vendor map to finalize table placement accurately — so everything on the vendor side is ready for a successful market.

 • Keep vendor data clean, current, and trustworthy, using Excel and strong number sense to catch errors before they reach event day.

 • Author and revise vendor Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to continuously improve our vendor systems and workflow.



Qualifications

 • 2-5 years in accounts receivable, billing, invoicing, or high-accuracy administrative/operations roles (e.g., AR, billing coordination, bookkeeping, law or medical office administration).

 • Proven accuracy with numbers and detail — you catch the wrong amount, the duplicate sign-up, or the unpaid vendor before it reaches event day.

 • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to run billing and communication across multiple events and markets at once without losing track.

 • Comfort enforcing deadlines and policies directly and professionally, while keeping vendor relationships warm.

 • Proficient in Notion (Notion is preferred but other project management softwares Clickup, Asana, Monday etc are acceptable as well)

 • Strong Excel skills and confidence working with data to keep records clean and trustworthy.

Experience with invoicing platforms — Square preferred.

 • Clear, professional written communication.

 • Comfort in a fast-paced environment where timelines and high volume are the norm.



Why Join CCS?

title: Content Strategist
description:
We are looking for a part-time content strategist to work alongside an established video marketing and monetization brand. This is not an entry-level role. We need someone who has done this before, can prove it, and has a clear system for how they work.



About the brand



Keenya Kelly is a video marketing and monetization strategist with a large established audience across TikTok, Instagram, and
. We teach entrepreneurs how to grow through short vertical video and turn their content into consistent income.



We have an active offer ecosystem including a membership, a flagship course, and low-ticket funnels. We are a systems-driven team that operates with clear processes, deadlines, and communication standards.



What we are looking for



You have a proven framework or methodology for creating content that grows accounts AND drives revenue. Not just views.



Not just followers. Actual conversions and sales.



You can show us accounts you have worked on, what the numbers looked like before you got involved, and what happened after. You think in systems. You do not wing it.



You have a repeatable process for researching a brand, building a content strategy, and delivering direction that a team can execute consistently.



You understand the difference between content that builds an audience and content that converts that audience into buyers — and you know how to build both into a strategy at the same time.



What this role involves



Deep dive into the Keenya Kelly brand — audience, offers, voice, content pillars, and competitors — and develop a content strategy tailored to where we are going, not just where we have been



Deliver weekly content ideas for Instagram,
, and TikTok — including hooks, format direction, caption angles, and CTAs that connect to our active offers



Deliver Trial Reels concept per day for Instagram



Build and hand over a content system our team can run — including a competitor database, hook library, and content direction framework



Join bi-weekly strategy calls to review performance and align on the next content cycle



Adapt content direction during active launch periods — we run live challenges, webinars, and course launch campaigns that require content to shift with the offer



What this role does NOT involve



You will not be posting, scheduling, editing videos, designing graphics, managing DMs or comments, or handling any execution. Our team handles all of that. Your job is strategy and content direction only.



You are the right person if



You have a documented system or framework for content strategy — not just experience, an actual repeatable process



You can show us at least two accounts you have grown that also became more profitable — with before and after numbers



You understand short vertical video deeply — TikTok, Instagram Reels, and
 — and you know how to build strategy differently for each platform



You are highly organized and can deliver on deadlines without being chased



You are comfortable working alongside a brand owner who is also a strategist — you do not need to own the entire process

to do your best work



You communicate proactively and do not go silent when things come up



This is not the right role if



You need to control execution in order to stand behind your strategy



You are still building your process and learning as you go



You cannot provide proof of accounts you have grown and monetized



You struggle with structure, deadlines, or communicating your own process clearly



How to apply



Your application must include:



1. A brief description of your content strategy framework or system — how you approach a new brand from day one



2. Two or more examples of accounts you have grown and helped monetize — include the platform, the follower growth, and the revenue or conversion results



3. Your availability and your rate for part-time consulting work



Applications that do not include proof of results will not be reviewed.

Vendor Account Manager

Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 9 AM – 5 PM US Eastern Time (10PM - 6AM Philippines Time)

About Charlie’s Collectible Show



Charlie's Collectible Show (CCS) is a family-friendly hobby and collectibles marketplace currently running weekly events in Atlanta and Houston, with Raleigh launching this year and Orlando and Chicago planned next. We host anime markets, TCG conventions, retro gaming expos, artist alleys, and competitive tournaments — bringing collectors, vendors, artists, and fans of anime, gaming, and collectibles together under one roof. Every event has free entry and free parking.



CCS is built on community. We create spaces where fandom connects in real life, and our vendors are at the center of that. As a Vendor Coordinator, you are the primary point of contact for the Family Vendors who make each show happen — recruiting them, onboarding them, and supporting them week to week. Their success is the business, and your role is to keep that relationship strong.



Position Summary



The Vendor Billing Manager owns the money and the accuracy behind every CCS event, across all locations. You lead a team of Vendor Coordinators from all CCS branches, overseeing vendor registration, invoicing, payment tracking, and event-readiness communication company-wide.



This is a leadership and accounts role, not general admin. It directly impacts revenue, vendor trust, and whether every event across every market runs clean. Your job is to make sure your coordinators have the systems, training, and support to approve the right vendors, collect every invoice on time, prevent overbooking, and get every vendor to event day knowing exactly where to go and what to expect.



We're looking for someone who is precise with numbers, organized under pressure, and able to lead a distributed team while holding the standard. You set the bar on billing accuracy, you catch problems before they reach event day, and you build the people and processes that scale as CCS grows.



Core Responsibilities

 • Lead and manage a team of three Vendor Coordinators (one per market), overseeing daily billing operations across all CCS locations and holding the team to consistent standards on accuracy, response time, and vendor experience.

 • Own billing oversight company-wide: monitor invoicing, payment tracking, and collections across every market, surface issues early, and step in to resolve escalated billing problems your coordinators can't.

 • Track overall event booking across all markets (20+ events per month combined): monitor booking levels, flag events running low so the marketing team can get a promotional push, and ensure no event is overbooked.

 • Own vendor communication end to end — supervise team to manage vendor inboxes and respond clearly, professionally, and on time.

 • Own the full vendor workflow from booking through event day: general communication, vendor prep support, load-in/load-out coordination, and building the vendor map to finalize table placement accurately — so everything on the vendor side is ready for a successful market.

 • Keep vendor data clean, current, and trustworthy, using Excel and strong number sense to catch errors before they reach event day.

 • Author and revise vendor Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to continuously improve our vendor systems and workflow.



Qualifications

 • 3-6 years in accounts receivable, billing, invoicing, or high-accuracy administrative/operations roles (e.g., AR, billing coordination, bookkeeping, law or medical office administration).

 • Proven accuracy with numbers and detail — you catch the wrong amount, the duplicate sign-up, or the unpaid vendor before it reaches event day.

 • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to run billing and communication across multiple events and markets at once without losing track.

 • Comfort enforcing deadlines and policies directly and professionally, while keeping vendor relationships warm.

 • Proficient in Notion (Notion is preferred but other project management softwares Clickup, Asana, Monday etc are acceptable as well)

 • Strong Excel skills and confidence working with data to keep records clean and trustworthy.

Experience with invoicing platforms — Square preferred.

 • Clear, professional written communication.

 • Comfort in a fast-paced environment where timelines and high volume are the norm.



Why Join CCS?

You won't just process invoices — you'll be the reason small-business owners trust us with their weekend, their booth, and their livelihood. Your accuracy keeps our revenue clean and shapes how every vendor experiences CCS. This is a high-impact role with real ownership and a clear path to lead: the on-ramp to Vendor Manager as we expand into Raleigh, Orlando, and Chicago. If you want to build strong systems that build strong communities, this is built for you.

title: Social Media QA
description:
Social Media QA Specialist & Client Communications Assistant (Part-Time, Remote)



Location: Remote (Philippines)

Hours: ~3 hours/day, Monday–Friday (15 hrs/week).

Compensation: $2.50/hour (~$150/month). (15% raise every 3 months until $5/hr)

Reports to: Account / Operations Lead



About the Role



We're a US-based digital marketing and video production agency managing automated social media posting across a roster of clients. As we've scaled, small errors have slipped through — duplicate posts, captions with typos, posts that didn't publish, wrong branding. We need a detail-obsessed person whose entire job is to make sure that never happens again.



This is a quality-control role first and a communications role second. If you take pride in catching the mistake everyone else missed, and you write clean, professional English, this is for you.



What You'll Do



Daily Post QA (the core of the role)

- Review every client's scheduled and automated posts before and after they go live

- Confirm each post actually published — on the right account, at the right time, with the right media

- Catch and flag duplicate posts before clients see them

- Proofread every caption for typos, grammar, and clarity

- Verify correct branding on every post: brand voice, 
 links, logos, and colors

- Check that all links work and UTM tracking is correct

- Confirm sponsored/partner content carries proper disclosure (e.g., #ad)

- Verify image/video quality, correct aspect ratios, and that the right asset was used

- Cross-check what's scheduled against the approved content calendar — flag anything missing, extra, or out of order

- When a post fails to publish, re-queue it or escalate immediately



Reporting & Process

- Keep a daily QA log of what was checked, what was caught, and what was fixed

- Flag recurring/patterned issues (e.g., "Client X's posts keep duplicating on Tuesdays") so we can fix root causes

- Help maintain and improve our QA checklist / SOP over time



Client Communication

- Send account reconnection notices when a client's connected platforms or integrations need re-authentication, and follow up until resolved

- Handle assigned client communications professionally and promptly over
 and chat

- Represent the agency with polished, friendly, error-free written English



What We're Looking For



Must-haves:

- Excellent written English — near-native, professional, and typo-free (you're our last line of defense against errors, so your own writing has to be flawless)

- Extreme attention to detail and a genuine satisfaction in catching mistakes

- Experience with social media schedulers / management tools (e.g., Meta Business Suite, Metricool, Later, Buffer, Hootsuite, Sprout, or similar)

- Reliable, self-managing, and consistent — this role lives or dies on day-in, day-out diligence

- Stable internet and a quiet work setup

- Comfortable juggling multiple client accounts without mixing them up



Nice-to-haves:

- Prior agency or social media management experience

- Familiarity with automation tools (ManyChat, 
, Zapier, etc.)

- Basic understanding of brand guidelines and how to apply them

- Light graphic/visual QA experience



Why Work With Us

- Steady, long-term part-time role with predictable hours

- Clear processes and direct communication — no chaos

- Performance-based raises and a year-end bonus

- Room to grow into a larger role as we expand



How to Apply



To show us you actually read this (attention to detail matters here), start your application with the word "PIXEL" so we know you're thorough.



In your application, please include:

1. A short note on why you'd be great at catching errors

2. Any social media management or QA tools you've used

3. An example of a time you caught a mistake others missed

4. Your expected monthly rate for ~25 hrs/week



We review applications for clean writing first — a single typo in your application tells us a lot for a QA role, so proofread carefully.

title: EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT - Finance & Operations Focused
description:
About NordStick



NordStick is a leading fitness brand founded in 2020 by a prominent physical therapist, dedicated to innovative home based workout solutions that help people overcome pain, prevent injuries, and achieve peak performance. Our flagship products, like the NordStick and NordBench Pro, are affordable, high quality, and multifunctional, empowering over 250,000 customers to build strength and improve mobility without a gym. As part of a fast growing DTC fitness ecosystem, we're committed to making health and wellness accessible. This is not a lifestyle brand. It is a long term company with high expectations around execution, ownership, and reliability.



The Role



We are hiring a Finance and Operations Focused Executive Assistant to support the Founder and keep the business running cleanly behind the scenes.



This is not bookkeeping or simple admin work.



You are responsible for making sure numbers match, processes are organized, vendors are handled, and operational details do not fall apart.



If something is messy, unclear, or late, you fix it.



If you prefer waiting for step by step instructions, this role will feel painful. If you naturally bring order to chaos, you will thrive.



Approximately 50% of your time will support customer service and operational tasks, with the rest focused on finance tracking, reporting, and systems.



Core Responsibilities



Execution Support and Ownership

--> Support the Founder across operational and financial initiatives

 --> Track priorities, deadlines, and dependencies across teams

 --> Follow up on deliverables and ensure nothing slips

 --> Turn direction into clear tasks and timelines



Finance and Data Management

--> Maintain and update Google Sheets for sales, expenses, inventory, and reporting

 --> Reconcile data across platforms to ensure numbers are accurate

 --> Track payouts, invoices, and vendor payments

 --> Assist with financial reporting and performance analysis

 --> Flag inconsistencies or risks before they become problems



Operations and Systems

--> Support Shopify operations and order workflows

 --> Help test and validate the full customer journey from purchase to fulfillment

 --> Assist with customer service platforms like Rich Panel

 --> Document processes and create simple SOPs

 --> Use AI tools to automate repetitive tasks and improve efficiency



Communication and Coordination

--> Coordinate with vendors, partners, and internal teams

 --> Prepare agendas and notes for check ins

 --> Keep communication tight, clear, and actionable

 --> Act as a central point of coordination across operations



What Success Looks Like



Within 30 Days

--> Reports and trackers are organized and accurate

 --> No preventable operational delays

 --> Founder is not chasing basic financial or CS details



Within 90 Days

--> Numbers are reliable and easy to understand

 --> Operations feel smooth and predictable

 --> Issues are caught early, not after damage is done

 --> Leadership focuses on growth, not fixing avoidable mistakes



Requirements

You should not apply unless most of the following are true:

--> You have supported operations, finance, or backend business functions before

 --> You are highly organized and detail obsessed

 --> You are comfortable working with numbers and spreadsheets daily

 --> You take ownership and solve problems independently

 --> You communicate clearly and directly

 --> You have experience with Google Sheets and ecommerce tools like Shopify

 --> You are comfortable learning new systems quickly

 --> You can commit full time, working 40 hours per week



How to Apply

Send a message with:

--> Your resume

 --> A brief overview of why you are a strong fit for this role

============================================================



RESPONSIBILITIES



MARKETING EXECUTION & CONTENT OPERATIONS



- Own and maintain the marketing content calendar across blog,
, and social channels.

- Ensure content is scheduled in advance and published on time.

- Execute marketing campaigns across content,
, social media, partnerships, and community channels.

- Coordinate, build, and publish blog posts, landing pages, newsletters, and marketing assets.

- Schedule and manage content across WordPress, LinkedIn,
, and other platforms.

- Create or coordinate supporting graphics, social assets, and lightweight video content.

- Support campaign launches, QA, reporting, and other marketing initiatives.



PROJECT & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COORDINATION



- Create and manage Trello cards for all marketing initiatives and ensure work is properly documented.

- Ensure every task card includes a clear and complete description, acceptance criteria, story points, release notes, and supporting documentation when applicable.

- Track weekly priorities, manage sprint commitments, and surface blockers proactively.

- Intake and coordinate marketing requests from other departments and ensure timely follow-up.



OPERATIONS & REPORTING



- Support weekly reporting on marketing activities, performance metrics, and completed initiatives.

- Help maintain consistency across folder structures, naming conventions, UTMs, metadata, and documentation.

- Assist with marketing QA, process improvements, and operational best practices.

- Ensure marketing assets, campaigns, and activities are properly organized and documented.



============================================================



WHAT YOU BRING



CORE REQUIREMENTS



- 1-3 years of experience in marketing coordination, project management, editorial operations, content marketing, or a related role.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Comfortable managing projects in Trello or similar project-management tools.

- Experience using WordPress, social scheduling tools, and Google Workspace.

- Intermediate SEO knowledge, including keyword research, on-page optimization, internal linking, metadata, and basic content-performance analysis.

- Strong written communication skills.

- Experience using Canva, Figma, or similar tools to create marketing visuals and short-form content.

- Ability to work with meaningful overlap during U.S. Central Time business hours.



WHAT WILL HELP YOU SUCCEED



- You are proactive and enjoy taking ownership of tasks from start to finish.

- You can research customer pain points, competitors, industry trends, and unfamiliar topics independently.

- You can turn technical, regulatory, or industry-specific concepts into clear, practical marketing content.

- You use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms to improve research, content creation, and productivity.

- You are curious and enjoy learning about regulated industries, compliance, identity verification, and emerging technologies.

- Familiarity with B2B SaaS marketing, ecommerce, and content-performance reporting is a plus.



============================================================



SCHEDULE



- Remote independent contractor role.

- Minimum 20 hours per week required.

- Meaningful overlap with U.S. Central Time business hours is required.

- Opportunity to expand to full-time, 40 hours per week, based on business needs, role fit, and performance.

- Please include your timezone, preferred working hours, and the amount of overlap you can provide with U.S. business hours in your application.



============================================================



COMPENSATION



Compensation depends on experience, availability, scope, and demonstrated ability to own marketing coordination and operational responsibilities.



Expected monthly compensation for a part-time schedule is $260-$650 per month, depending on agreed weekly hours and experience.



Candidates who grow into a full-time schedule may be considered for a monthly compensation range of $520-$1,040 per month, depending on scope, performance, and business needs.



Please include your expected monthly compensation in your application.



============================================================



HOW TO APPLY



Use this subject line:



TRUST - Growth Marketing Coordinator Application



Please send:



1. RESUME OR LINKEDIN PROFILE

- Include a link to your most up-to-date resume, LinkedIn profile, or portfolio.



2. COMPENSATION AND AVAILABILITY

- Confirm that you reviewed the compensation ranges listed above and that they fit within your expected monthly compensation.

- List your expected monthly compensation.

- List your hours available per week.

- List your timezone.

- List your preferred working hours.

- State the amount of overlap you can provide with U.S. Central Time business hours.

- State your earliest possible start date.



3. MARKETING OWNERSHIP STORY

- In 5-8 sentences, describe one marketing campaign, content workflow, project-coordination challenge, or publishing process you owned from start to finish.

- Explain what happened, what you did, how you kept the work organized, and what changed as a result.



4. PROCESS IMPROVEMENT EXAMPLE

- Briefly describe one calendar, workflow, QA checklist, reporting process, Trello setup, SOP, or handoff you improved.



5. SHORT WRITTEN EXERCISE

A campaign is scheduled to launch in three days, but the landing page is incomplete, design assets are missing, and approval status is unclear.



Please answer:

- What would you do first?

- What information would you gather?

- Who would you involve and why?

- How would you organize the work and keep stakeholders updated through launch?



6. AI USAGE NOTE

Tell us how you used AI, if at all, to complete this application:

- Which sections did AI help with?

- Where did you rely on your own judgment?

- How did you verify that your final answer reflected your actual experience and thinking?



Applications that do not follow these instructions may not be reviewed.



============================================================



HIRING PROCESS



After initial application review, selected candidates may be asked to confirm role requirements, compensation fit, long-term interest, independent-contractor status, no agency or subcontracting relationship, time-tracking expectations, background-check willingness, and integrity expectations.



Finalists may be asked to complete a short intro video and a paid trial project before final interviews.

title: Advanced OpenAI API/RAG Developer
description:
OpenAI API / RAG Developer Needed — Laravel + Vue.js Project

Looking for the best of the best developers. You will be working next to me, the CTO, on this project and open a door to being our Senior Engineer/Lead Developer or other possibilities.



REQUIRE APPLICATION ASSIGNMENT

Applications will likely not be considered unless both assignments are included.

If either of these assignments seems complicated, unfamiliar, or like it would take you substantial time, please do not apply. A qualified developer for this role should be able to build both of these from scratch in roughly an hour. I am not interested in paying someone to learn these tools from zero.



I can help with project-specific details once we begin, but you will be helping develop an ongoing production project that depends on these foundations over the next couple months. There is potential for a full-time development position based on performance.



Assignment 1 — RAG AI Agent Demo

Provide either:

A live demo,

A sendable locally hostable demo,

Or a past project demo you have already built.



The demo should show a basic RAG AI agent. Preferably, it should read a PDF and provide accurate RAG-based answers about the PDF contents.

I can provide an OpenAI API key if needed.



Assignment 2 — Live Context Switching Chatbot Demo

Provide a short demo of a chatbot where the bot context can be changed live using a UI button.

The same API connection and the same stored single-session chat history should remain active, but the bot’s live context should switch and affect the AI/tool-call output.



Initial context:

My favorite color is red.

Tool output:

Red



Then the user clicks a context switch button.



New context:

My favorite food is green apples because I love green.

Tool output:

Green



The purpose of this assignment is to show that you understand live context switching, session chat history, and AI tool-call behavior inside the same active session.

I can provide an OpenAI API key if needed.



We are hiring a developer for an ongoing OpenAI API related project. This is not a beginner project. We need someone who already understands RAG, OpenAI API workflows, tool calls, context handling, and practical web app integration.



Our application is built with Laravel, PHP, Vue.js, JavaScript, and HTML5. Experience with PHP and JavaScript/HTML5 is mandatory. Laravel experience is highly preferred. Vue.js experience is preferred, but a strong JavaScript developer should be able to adapt quickly.



This project may require direct use of the OpenAI REST API instead of relying only on OpenAI SDKs.



Required Skills

OpenAI API experience

RAG implementation experience

Tool/function calling experience

REST API experience

PHP

Laravel

JavaScript

HTML5

Vue.js or strong ability to learn Vue quickly

PDF parsing / document ingestion experience preferred

Ability to build clean demos quickly without heavy hand-holding

Good English proficiency is required. There will be a live interview during the hiring process.



Some EST timezone overlap is preferred. I am also typically available from 7:00 AM to 12:00 PM PHT.

title: Video Editor
description:
About Blue Zone:

We’re Blue Zone, a rebellious pet nutrition brand from the Netherlands on a mission to give dogs their longest, healthiest lives. We do this with our air-dried, raw-quality dog food that’s as honest as it gets. No marketing fluff. No filler. Just real food, built on truth and transparency.



Now, we’re looking for a skilled and motivated video editor to help bring our message to life across digital channels. You’ll be crafting high-converting, emotionally compelling ad creatives that tell our story in a way people actually want to watch.



Your Mission (if you choose to accept it):

You’ll be turning raw content, user-generated videos, brand video’s, and brand messaging into attention demanding content. Think short-form edits, voiceover-led explainer reels, and a whole lot of creativity in between.



We're not your average pet brand. So we don’t want average creatives. We’re growing fast, and we’re here to shake things up.



What We’re Looking For:

- Strong Editing Skills

You’re a master at Premiere Pro & After Effects and know how to turn raw footage into compelling short-form content. High-quality transitions, pacing, and storytelling are your jam.

- Quick to Learn, Quick to Adapt

We move fast, so you need to be comfortable with quick feedback loops, tools, and our systems.



- Reliable and Communicative

We don’t micromanage, but we do expect clear communication and fast delivery. If something’s unclear or blocking you, you speak up early.



- Eager to Improve

You’re open to feedback, love to grow, and aren’t precious about revisions. We’ll support your growth with editing guides and brand templates.



Must-Haves

- Fluent in English (written + spoken)

- 2+ year of video editing experience

- Tools you already use; After Effects & Premiere Pro

- Solid sense of visual design: spacing, color, contrast, hierarchy

- Comfortable using AI tools

- Minimum availability: 40 hours/week



What You’ll Get

- A long-term, remote role with a fast-growing brand

- A creative-first team where your input matters & you can make an actual impact

- Freedom to grow your role and responsibilities

- Access to ready-made assets, AI tools, and a clear process

- A company mission worth standing behind (and a few very cute dog photos)



Compensation

- Approx. $800/month full-time

- Growth opportunities as we scale



How to Apply

1. Complete the form & trial task linked below:


/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfeyjzydXLlXp8sieHSxEdVSIhCeb1WH6dnJohUN1FvzDkaBg/viewform?usp=header

2. Send your edit along with your portfolio or relevant work

3. Include the word “Bulalo” in your message, so we know you’re paying attention



We can’t wait to meet you,



Dean



CEO, Blue Zone

title: URGENT: AI UGC Video Creator/Editor -  1 SPOT only ( this is NOT for beginners )

You’ll work directly with our amazing manager ( 20 years old from Europe, with over 3 years of real experience in this exact space ), who has personally prepared A FEW HOURS step-by-step tutorials on Loom to teach you everything from the ground up.

No confusion. No guessing. No wasted time. ( Most tea
mbers learned the workflow within a few days and are now working fully independently )







What kind of videos will you create?

Simple UGC-like short-form videos fully based on the provided scripts by us. Some of them are silently advertising products at the end but the key is that it doesn't sound like an ad but rather a native short-form video which a real person/influencer would record with their iPhone. There are a few styles such as just a calm "sit down" video ( where there's only one image and the influencer would just talk for 2 minutes ) or other ones where there're a few "shots" of them with a few seconds each and the scenes change but it's really not difficult at all - just a few more generations and then connecting them in CapCut.





The process is straightforward:

Getting our scripts ready and approved, using your own creativity and generating high quality base images using tools like Nano Banana Pro, turning these images into video clips using platforms like Veo3, voice cloning it, dead air cuts and trimming, other minor adjustments such as background audio effects if needed ( like supermarket background audio ). Whole process is 90% just creating the right images/video clips etc. Everything is shown clearly in the training.



You’ll be creating a lot of videos a day but these are not complex edits AT ALL. Difficulty level: 6/10 ( again, 80% is just generating the rate "input" images and later just animating them with voice. That's it )





Here are visual examples of what the videos look like ( NOT OURS ):

1. 

2. 

3. 



( In your application, let us know your thoughts, do you think you can easily recreate them - what tools would you use and why? )





Training & onboarding ( this is the biggest advantage )

Once hired, you will receive structured video tutorials. In total, we have a few hours available, though most people don’t need all of it. The workflow is clear so no missing steps and no “figure it out yourself.”







Daily workload ( important )

You’ll create around 10 to 20+ videos per day ( 1 to 2 min long - we’ll start with a smaller amount and later increase it - won't negatively affect your monthly pay. We just want to make it easier for you to start - ultimately we'll be doing 20+ but making sure it's under 8-10h a day, at first it may take you longer and we may work harder - but once learned it easily becomes manageable ).

In reality, you'd have exactly 4 unique "AI influencers" but all of 4 them have the same scripts to use, you'd just need to change a few words to help with the context ( some of them might be talking only about "dogs" but some about "cats" so just need to change a few words to make it all make sense ) and you could use the same image prompts to generate almost identical images for each influencer. In reality it’s just 2 to 6 original videos PER INFLUENCER ( 4 of them ) and each with a very similar structure. Once trained, this is very manageable.



Your job is simple:

Create the videos, export them, and send them to us daily on our Google Drive.

That’s it. No posting. No account management. No stress.







Equipment & storage ( we make this easy )

You’ll need a good computer that can smoothly handle 1080p/light 4k video editing ( we’ll do 1080p but we’re going to work on multiple browser tabs ), a stable internet connection, and at least 16GB of RAM and 250GB+ of fast storage AVAILABLE. 1TB+ of SSD storage is preferred ( make sure it’s SSD and not old and slow HDD ).







Tools & software ( HUGE upside )

You get FREE access to Veo3 ULTRA costing $200+ and many more in near future!,

We provide logins, instructions, and full support.





Work environment & communication

You’ll have a private 1:1 chat with our manager and separate one to send your daily work in, work fully remotely through 
, receive clear feedback, and be treated as a long-term tea
mber, not disposable labor.

No stressful interviews. No micromanagement. No slow
s back and forth.







Responsibilities

- Adjust our scripts for the context

- Create videos from start to finish.

- Export and send them on Google Drive.

- Apply feedback and improve.

- Prepare scripts for the next day.

- Organize files properly.

- Communicate clearly.

- Hit deadlines without reminders.

That’s it. Simple, repetitive, and enjoyable.







This job is perfect for you if

You’re looking for long-term stability ( months or years ), you’re willing to learn, tech-savvy, creative, organized, and able to focus consistently. You already have video creation/editing experience. Already done some AI influencers related jobs and have good experience in: Google VEO3, Nano Banana Pro, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, CapCut PRO and other similar tools. Your computer can handle multiple tabs open ( A LOT of them ). You care about doing things properly, understand and speak English well, respond to messages quickly, and can work up to 6 days per week. You’re a young, talented, smart individual. You’re okay with a slightly heavier learning phase in the first week, you’re not afraid to ask questions, you’re reliable and honest about mistakes.

We value dedication, reliability, and improvement more than raw talent.







This job is not for you if

You’re looking for quick money, disappear without communication, can’t focus, you’re on the older side and have never edited 1 video in your life, never played with the AI tools mentioned above, your computer can’t handle having multiple tabs open at the same time, have unstable internet, refuse feedback, rush work carelessly, avoid consistency, or cannot communicate in English.







Salary & payments

This is a full-time position, starting at 6 days per week, under 10 hours per day. ( ultimately under 8h once you become very efficient, which our manager will help you achieve and it won't impact your salary working less - quite the opposite! )



Starting salary ranges from around $440-$540/month based on experience, with the potential in the future to increase to $540+ based on a few factors such as performance, dedication, and quality of work.



Payments are monthly, in any currency or method available in your country. ( we’ll try )



To build trust, we’re offering to pay you $100 after the first week of working with us, with the remaining balance at month end. ( we already got scammed by other platforms so please respect this )



And remember, we cover $300+ dollars/month for paid tools so you can get them for FREE meaning your pay is actually 100% profit + refunds for any costs of yours. ( meaning in theory your total compensation is closer to $8000+ including tool access )

Role Title: Video Editor - Volume Lane 



 Video Editor - Volume Lane 

High-throughput short-form editor who owns one content lane and produces clean, on-brand cuts fast, to a template. 





Primary Goal 

Turn raw footage, talking-head, creator calls, simple scripted pieces, into polished short-form videos at high volume, following established templates, brand presets, and references. Success is measured by consistent daily output at a reliable quality bar, not by creative reinvention. 





Where This Role Sits 

You are assigned one primary content lane (for example: scripted talking-head, reply-to-comment clips, or creator-call highlight clips). A producer hands you organized footage, a template, and a reference; you execute. This is a focused, repeatable role for someone who likes to get into flow and ship. 





Key Responsibilities 

• Edit raw footage into finished short-form videos (TikTok, Reels, Shorts) using provided templates and brand presets. 

• Apply captions, basic text overlays, clean cuts, and audio cleanup to a consistent standard. 

• Hit a daily output target without dropping below the quality floor. 

• Multiply each approved cut into platform-native variants,  turning one finished piece into several posts across TikTok, Reels, Shorts, LinkedIn, and
 (aspect ratio, length, caption style). 

• Keep project files, exports, and assets organized and named per our system. 

• Use AI tools (Claude, OpusClip, 
) to speed up culling, rough cuts, and reformatting. 





Required Skills & Tools 

• Core editing: Descript and/or CapCut (required); Adobe Premiere a plus. 

• Captioning workflows and platform-native formatting for TikTok / Reels / Shorts. 

• AI-assisted editing: OpusClip, 
; comfortable working alongside Claude. 

• Collaboration: Google Workspace, Slack / Lark, Loom. 





Experience 

1–2+ years editing short-form social content. Hungry, fast-learning editors early in their career are welcome, we would rather build good habits than undo bad ones. 





What We Screen For 

• Speed with consistency: a high volume of clean edits per day, every day, to a template. 

• Lane discipline and coachability: thrives inside a defined system; does not need creative control or to make the content their own. 

• Reliability: predictable daily throughput we can build a pipeline around. 





Not a fit if: you want a creative-director track, heavy input on concept/strategy, or get restless doing the same content type repeatedly. That is a different role, see Story / Hero Editor.

title: Video Editor - Story / Hero
description:
Role Title: Video Editor - Story / Hero



Video Editor - Story / Hero 

Senior craft editor who pulls narrative out of raw footage and sets the quality bar for the team. 





Primary Goal 



Produce our highest-impact pieces, story-driven creator wins, narrative cutdowns from long-form calls and podcasts, and high-retention hero content. Working from raw footage without a tight template. Over time, help define editing standards and act as a quality checkpoint for the volume team. 





Where This Role Sits 



This is the senior editing seat. You take a 45-minute creator call or podcast and find the 45-second story inside it: the hook, the turn, the payoff. You work from brand voice and judgment, not just a preset, and you grow into a quality checkpoint and mentor for the volume-lane editors. 





Key Responsibilities 



• Cut narrative-driven short-form from long-form source (creator calls, podcasts, interviews): find the story, structure tension ? turn ? takeaway. 

• Identify and cut the multiple strongest stories within a single long-form source, not just one. 

• Produce hero / high-retention pieces with advanced pacing, dynamic cuts, motion graphics, and sound design. 

• Translate brand voice into editing decisions so every piece feels on-brand. 

• Build and document templates and presets the volume team can reuse. 

• QC volume-team output, give actionable feedback, and help onboard new editors. 





Required Skills & Tools 



• Advanced editing: Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve (required); Descript (required). 

• Story instinct: able to find and structure a narrative from raw, unscripted footage. 

• Motion graphics, dynamic captioning, sound design, and color. 

• AI-assisted workflows (Claude, OpusClip) to accelerate selects and assembly. 





Experience 



3+ years editing short-form and/or narrative content, ideally for creators or personal brands. 

A portfolio that demonstrates storytelling, not just effects. 





What We Screen For 



• Story sense over technical flash: we will take a strong storyteller over a technically flawless editor whose cuts don’t land. Ask candidates to show a piece where they pulled a story out of messy footage. 

• Brand-voice judgment: can keep content feeling like one person across formats. 

• Leadership trajectory: can eventually own standards and coach others.

title: Conversion Rate Optimisation Specialist & AB Tester
description:
Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Shopify Specialist / A/B Testing Expert

Remote | Full-Time (40 Hours per Week) | Independent Contractor

 Location: Remote (Worldwide, excluding Germany, Pakistan, and India)

 Working Hours: 40 hours per week (CET time zone)

 Employment Type: Independent Contractor (exclusive engagement with our company, 40 hours/week)

 Compensation: Competitive compensation based on skills, experience, and proven results.



About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and highly analytical Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Specialist / Shopify A/B Testing Expert to join our growing team.

The ideal candidate must have deep hands-on experience with Shopify e-commerce platforms, advanced A/B testing methodologies, and conversion optimization strategies. You will be responsible for identifying growth opportunities, developing experimentation strategies, executing A/B and multivariate tests, and delivering measurable improvements in conversion rates, revenue, and customer experience.

You will work closely with our marketing, design, and development teams to optimize customer journeys and improve overall business performance through continuous experimentation and data-driven decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Plan, execute, and analyze A/B tests and multivariate experiments across Shopify stores, including landing pages, product pages, collections, checkout flows, and other critical customer touchpoints.

Own the CRO roadmap by identifying conversion opportunities and prioritizing experiments based on potential business impact.

Develop data-driven hypotheses and testing strategies focused on increasing conversion rates, revenue, customer engagement, and retention.

Apply deep Shopify knowledge to optimize store performance, user experience, and conversion funnels.

Collaborate with designers, developers, and marketers to create, implement, and evaluate test variations.

Analyze customer behavior using tools such as Google Analytics, GA4, Hotjar, and other analytics and behavioral tracking platforms.

Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide actionable recommendations based on test results.

Create clear and detailed reports covering experiment performance, insights, learnings, and business impact.

Continuously improve customer journeys through ongoing experimentation, analysis, and optimization.



Required Qualifications

Minimum 3+ years of professional experience in Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), A/B testing, and digital experimentation.

Deep hands-on experience working with Shopify and Shopify Plus stores is mandatory.

Proven experience designing, implementing, analyzing, and scaling successful A/B testing programs in e-commerce environments.

Strong understanding of CRO frameworks, UX principles, customer psychology, and e-commerce conversion funnels.

Experience with A/B testing platforms, analytics tools, and behavioral analysis solutions.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and convert insights into actionable growth strategies.

Experience working closely with designers and developers to implement testing variations.

Excellent attention to detail, communication skills, and problem-solving ability.

Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a remote environment.

Availability during CET business hours.

Strong written and spoken English.

Applicants must reside outside of Germany.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with WordPress/WooCommerce.

Experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads.

Experience working with high-volume e-commerce stores and direct-to-consumer brands.



How to Apply

To apply, please submit your CV together with a detailed cover letter.

Please include clear and concise responses to the following:

Your salary expectations.

Confirmation that you are available to work exclusively with KU Europe GmbH.

An overview of the A/B tests and experiments you have personally planned, implemented, and analyzed, including measurable outcomes where possible. There is no need to cover minor details.

The tools and platforms you have used for testing, analytics, tracking, and optimization.

The e-commerce platforms you have worked with, particularly Shopify and Shopify Plus.

Relevant case studies, portfolio examples, supporting materials, or links that demonstrate your CRO and experimentation expertise.

Please keep your responses focused, highlighting your hands-on experience with CRO Shopify & AB Testing, key contributions, and measurable impact.

We are specifically seeking candidates with proven hands-on CRO experience across Shopify and Shopify Plus stores, strong A/B testing and experimentation skills, and a demonstrated ability to drive measurable improvements in conversion rates, revenue, and other key business metrics through data-driven decision-making.

title: Social Media Officer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: SOCIAL MEDIA OFFICER



About BANTU Philippines

BANTU Philippines is a grassroots youth development organization in San Andres Bukid, Manila. Through a range of programs including Capoeira Angola, sports, dance, coaching and supporting nutrition, we work with street kids to build community, life skills and brighter futures.

CASA BANTU is our youth center — part home, part hangout, part martial arts, music, dance and art space. The aim is not to market ourselves as just a charity but as a social movement. 



The Role

We are looking for a Social Media Officer who understands what we do — and can translate it into content that moves people. You will manage BANTU's online presence with the creative freedom to bring our work and kids’ stories to life the way they deserve.

This is a part-time role. You will come on-site 1–2 times per month to shoot, and handle planning, writing, and editing remotely.



The Aesthetic & Voice

Young. Energetic. Authentic.

Raw when it needs to be — joyful when it needs to be. We do not do polished poverty porn. We do not do savior narratives. We show real kids doing extraordinary things.

Our voice is confident, nationalistic, and story-first. English proficiency is a necessity. Captions that move people, not perform for them.



Responsibilities

Plan and execute a monthly content calendar aligned with BANTU's campaigns and events

Shoot on-site 1–2 times per month, coordinated around program activities

Edit and post content across
, Instagram, Tiktok and LinkedIn

Write all captions in English (we discourage the use of 100% AI produced texts on socials) 

Coordinate with BANTU leadership on campaign messaging and brand consistency

Repurpose existing footage and photos when on-site shooting isn't needed



What You'll Need

Experience running social media for a brand, NGO, or community organization

Strong English writing — you should be able to tell a story in three sentences

Shooting and basic editing skills (phone-quality is fine if the eye is good)

Genuine alignment with BANTU's mission 

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision



Terms of Engagement

Type: Part-time, remote 

On-site: 1–2 shoot days per month, coordinated in advance

Remote: Content planning, writing, scheduling

Starting retainer: ?8,000/month. 



To Apply

Send your portfolio and with photo and video samples to: 





We review applications on a rolling basis.

title: AI Creative Specialist
description:
TO APPLY

If this opportunity feels like the perfect fit for you and you meet the job qualifications, we invite you to learn more about our HiEnd Accents team in the Philippines and submit your application here:


com/appzq4iqeIREQRVyo/pagWFW91EJQpT08fw/form NOTE: Change the word "(dot)" to an actual dot.



Applications submitted through onlinejobs.ph will not be reviewed.



JOB DESCRIPTION



We're looking for a full-time AI Creative Specialist to lead the creation of AI-generated product imagery, lifestyle scenes, and short-form video for our brands, including HiEnd Accents and Paseo Road. You'll take our products from a flat studio shot to fully-realized lifestyle photography and video creative used across our website, paid social ads,
 campaigns, and Pinterest. You'll own the full pipeline: writing prompts, generating images and videos with tools like Gemini (Nano Banana Pro), Midjourney, Kling, and Veo, finishing them in Photoshop/Canva if needed, and assembling them into finished ad creatives.



We are looking for a long-term tea
mber who will stay and grow at our company. We offer competitive compensation and a good work environment.





WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Generate photorealistic lifestyle product photography using AI image tools (Gemini / Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, or similar), placing our bedding, pillows, rugs, and home textiles into believable room scenes, on-model shots, and editorial-style compositions



- Animate hero images into short-form video using Kling, Veo 3/3.1, or comparable image-to-video tools for use in Meta ads, Pinterest, TikTok, and on-site PDP video



- Write, test, and continuously refine your own prompts, building reusable prompt templates and a library of looks that maintain visual consistency across each brand



- Build finished static and video ad creatives (Meta, Pinterest, Google) by combining AI-generated imagery with on-brand text overlays, logos, and sizing variants



- Finish and retouch every AI output in Photoshop, Canva, and/or Lightroom, fixing hands, edges, lighting, fabric texture, and any AI artifacts before delivery so nothing leaves your hands looking AI-generated



- Quality-check every output against the actual product reference photos before anything goes out the door, comparing print patterns, color, scale, flange widths, fabric texture, stitching, and proportions to the real product side by side, and regenerating or retouching until the match is exact



- Maintain brand consistency across every output, staying within each brand's color palette, lighting style, prop language, and overall aesthetic (HiEnd Accents vs. Paseo Road vs. our other brands)



- Iterate quickly on feedback from the marketing and creative teams, delivering multiple variations and revisions per brief



- Organize and tag final assets in our shared library (Google Drive, Airtable, Notion) so the rest of the team can find and reuse them



- Track what's working, which creatives are performing on ads, which prompts are producing the best output, and feed those learnings into the next round



- Stay current on new AI image and video tools, model updates, and prompting techniques, and bring promising ones to the team





WHO YOU ARE



- Significant prior experience generating photorealistic product or lifestyle imagery with AI tools (Gemini / Nano Banana Pro, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, or similar) required



- Strong prompt engineering skills: you can read a product brief and write a prompt that nails the scene, mood, and composition on the first or second pass



- Hands-on experience with AI image-to-video tools such as Kling, Veo 3/3.1, Runway, or Pika, with a portfolio of short clips you've produced



- Proficient in Adobe Photoshop, Canva, or Lightroom for retouching and finishing AI outputs (fixing artifacts, color correction, compositing) and for ad layout and text treatment



- A sharp eye for photorealism: you can spot the tells of AI-generated work (warped elements, melted textures, unnatural shadows, off proportions on furniture and textiles, etc.) and fix them before anyone else sees the file



- Obsessive attention to product accuracy: when comparing your AI output to the actual product photo, you catch the small stuff (a print motif that's slightly off, a flange width that's wrong by a quarter inch, a color that's a shade too warm) and fix it before delivery. The bar is exact match to the real product, not "looks close enough"



- Excellent English skills with high attention to detail and meticulous proofreading of any text or copy in your creatives



- A genuine sense of style and taste in interior design, home decor, and product photography; you understand why a room looks expensive vs. AI-generated stock



- Self-motivated, organized, and professional, with the ability to multi-task and prioritize across multiple brands and brief types; able to work independently with minimal supervision



- Comfortable working with our team via
, Slack, and Zoom. Highly preferred, but not required: experience with Airtable, Notion, Slack, and Google Drive



- Full-time position, 40 hrs/week



- Commitment to the company's mission and values, which can be found here: 



- Excel as a team player, contributing positively to our collective success.





ABOUT HIEND ACCENTS



HiEnd Accents designs and sells premium bedding and home textiles (quilts, sheets, decorative pillows, duvets, and more) that bring everyday luxury into people's homes. We've been family-owned and operated since 2005, now in our second generation of leadership, and are headquartered in Dallas, Texas.



We serve thousands of retailers, interior designers, department stores, and boutique hotels across the United States through four distinct brands spanning a range of styles and price points. Our growth has been recognized nationally: we've been named to the Inc. 5000 (a prestigious list of America's fastest-growing private companies) two years running, and have received multiple industry awards for product excellence.



We're a company of around 45 people, small enough that every person matters, established enough that you're joining something real and growing.



Discover more at 
.





WHY HIEND ACCENTS?



We're growing our team in the Philippines because we believe in finding the best people regardless of geography, and investing in them for the long term.



As a family-owned company, we don't treat our tea
mbers as interchangeable. We take the time to build real working relationships, we care about your professional development, and we want every person who works with us to leave with stronger skills than when they started. That's a genuine commitment from our leadership, not a line in a job posting.



What you can expect:



You'll work directly with our core team in Texas, not through layers of management or a BPO intermediary. Your contributions will be visible, your ideas heard, and your growth supported.



- Compensation & Benefits: Competitive pay benchmarked to PH market rates for skilled roles, not entry-level floors. Paid time off including vacation days and holidays, plus 13th-month pay.

title: Full-Time Remote Dispatcher for U.S. Pedicab / Taxi Operation — Strong English Required
description:
This is a live dispatch role, not a basic VA job. Strong spoken and written English is required.



Full-Time Remote Dispatcher / Operations Assistant — Ocean City, Maryland Pedicab Company



Atlantic Pedicabs is hiring a full-time remote dispatcher and operations assistant to help manage our live pedicab transportation operation in Ocean City, Maryland, USA.



This is not a basic virtual assistant role. This is a real-time operations position for a transportation company operating on the boardwalk of one of the busiest East Coast vacation destinations in the United States.



We are looking for someone reliable, sharp, calm under pressure, highly organized, and excellent at spoken and written English.



Position Overview:



You will be helping manage live pedicab trips on the Ocean City, Maryland Boardwalk. Our riders provide transportation to tourists, families, restaurant guests, hotel guests, and visitors along the boardwalk.



As a dispatcher, you will be monitoring:



* Trips currently in progress

* Trips that were recently completed

* Trips that are scheduled or coming up soon

* Rider location and availability

* Customer messages and calls

* Rider messages and operational issues

* Delays, route questions, pickup issues, and customer service problems



You will need to become very familiar with the Ocean City, Maryland Boardwalk, including hotels, restaurants, attractions, street numbers, landmarks, pickup areas, and common destinations.



This role requires focus, common sense, and strong communication. You will be helping us keep the operation moving smoothly while riders are actively working in the field.



## Schedule



This is a full-time role.



Hours are:



**2:00 PM to 12:00 AM Eastern Standard Time / Eastern Time**

**5 days per week**

**50 hours per week**



Days off will likely be either:



* Tuesday and Wednesday off

  or

* Monday and Tuesday off



You must be available to work during U.S. Eastern Time hours. Please do not apply if you cannot reliably work this schedule.



## Starting Pay



Starting pay is:



**$4.00 USD per hour**



This is a starting rate. There is room for growth for the right person as we build trust, stability, and expand the company.



We are not looking for short-term freelancers. We are looking for someone who wants to grow with us and become part of our long-term operations team.



## Paid Time Off and Benefits



We believe in taking care of the people who take care of our company.



For long-term tea
mbers, we offer:



* **2 weeks of paid vacation during the winter**

* **Paid Christmas Eve off**

* **Paid Christmas Day off**

* **Paid New Year’s Eve off**

* **Paid New Year’s Day off**

* **Paid Easter off**



We operate heavily during the busy summer season, so winter is when our team has more time to rest. We want serious people who work hard during the season and can build a stable long-term role with us.



## About the Company



Atlantic Pedicabs operates pedicab transportation services in the United States for over 10 years. We currently operate in New Jersey and Ocean City, Maryland, and we are building systems that will allow us to expand into additional cities in the future.



Our Ocean City, Maryland operation serves the boardwalk, hotels, restaurants, tourists, families, and visitors. During the busy summer season, this is a fast-moving live transportation environment.



We have been working with virtual assistants for years and currently have virtual assistants in-house who have a close relationship with our company. We treat our people like family, and we are happy to have our current tea
mbers speak with serious candidates as references so you can understand what it is like to work with us.



We have contact with our team every single day. This is not a cold, distant, anonymous online job. We work closely together, communicate daily, and build real trust with the people who join our company.



We value loyalty, communication, accountability, punctuality, and long-term relationships.



## Our Standards



The bar is set high by our current VA staff.



Our current tea
mbers take punctuality seriously. They check in a few minutes early every single day. They communicate clearly, take ownership of their work, and treat the operation with professionalism.



We expect the same standard from anyone new joining the team.



Please do not apply if you are not a serious professional looking to join our standard of operating. We are not looking for someone who simply wants another online side job. We are looking for someone who is reliable, focused, coachable, and serious about being part of a high-performing team.



If you are late, unreliable, hard to reach, careless with communication, or casual about attendance, this role will not be a good fit.



If you are serious, punctual, loyal, professional, and want to grow with a company that treats its people like family, we would like to hear from you.



## Main Responsibilities



Your responsibilities will include:



### Live Trip Management



* Monitor active pedicab trips in real time

* Watch for delays, missed pickups, rider issues, customer confusion, and trip problems

* Help make sure riders are assigned properly

* Help make sure trips are completed correctly

* Follow up on recently completed trips when needed

* Monitor upcoming trips and make sure they are not missed

* Communicate quickly when a trip needs attention



### Customer Communication



* Communicate with customers by phone, text, app messaging, or other company communication tools

* Answer questions about rides, pickup locations, timing, pricing, and general service

* Help customers find the correct pickup location

* Handle customer confusion professionally

* Calm down upset or frustrated customers

* Escalate serious issues to management when needed

* Use professional, friendly, clear English at all times



### Rider Communication



* Communicate with pedicab riders working in the field

* Help riders understand trip details

* Help coordinate pickups and drop-offs

* Follow up with riders about delays or trip issues

* Make sure riders are staying active, responsive, and professional

* Report rider problems to management

* Keep communication clear, direct, and respectful



### Boardwalk Location Knowledge



You will be expected to become very familiar with Ocean City, Maryland, especially the boardwalk area.



You will need to learn:



* Major hotels

* Popular restaurants

* Boardwalk attractions

* Street numbers

* Common pickup and drop-off areas

* Landmarks

* Busy areas

* Restricted or confusing areas

* Common tourist destinations



You do not need to know this on day one, but you must be willing to study and learn the area quickly. This is extremely important to the role.



### Dispatch and Operations Support



You may also help with:



* Reservation monitoring

* Schedule updates

* Rider attendance tracking

* Daily shift notes

* Customer service logs

* Trip issue reports

* App/admin system tasks

* Basic data entry

* End-of-shift reporting

* Communicating operational issues to management



## Required Skills



Please do not apply unless you have **strong spoken and written English**.



This role requires live communication with American customers and American staff. Clear English is not optional. It is one of the most important requirements of the job.



You must have:



* Excellent written English

* Strong spoken English

* Good listening skills

* Ability to communicate clearly and professionally

* Ability to stay calm under pressure

* Strong attention to detail

* Fast response time

* Good judgment

* Reliability

* Punctuality

* Ability to check in before your shift starts

* Ability to work independently

* Ability to follow systems and procedures

* Willingness to learn a live transportation operation

* Willingness to work U.S. Eastern Time hours



## Preferred Experience



Experience in any of the following is helpful:



* Dispatching

* Taxi, rideshare, delivery, logistics, or transportation operations

* Customer service

* Call center work

* Virtual assistant work

* Travel, hotel, tourism, or hospitality support

* Live chat support

* Phone support

* Operations assistant roles

* Scheduling or appointment coordination

* CRM or dispatch software

* Google Maps or map-based work



You do not need to have pedicab experience. We can train the right person. But you must be smart, reliable, communicative, and willing to learn.



## Personality Fit



The right person for this role is:



* Calm under pressure

* Fast to respond

* Not easily overwhelmed

* Comfortable with live operations

* Very organized

* Honest

* Loyal

* Detail-oriented

* Good with people

* Able to solve problems

* Not afraid to ask questions

* Willing to take ownership of the role

* Serious about punctuality and attendance

* Looking for long-term work, not short-term side gigs



This job can be busy. You may have multiple rides, riders, and customers needing attention at the same time. We need someone who can think clearly and communicate professionally even when things are moving fast.



## Technology Requirements



You must have:



* Reliable high-speed internet

* A quiet work environment

* A working computer

* A reliable headset or microphone

* Backup internet plan preferred

* Ability to use web-based software, messaging apps, maps, spreadsheets, and dispatch/admin tools



Because this is a live dispatch role, reliability is extremely important. Internet problems, power problems, or repeated missed shifts will not work for this position.



## Growth Opportunity



We are building a long-term team.



This role starts as a dispatcher / operations assistant, but there is room to grow into a larger operations role as the company expands.



Future growth may include:



* Senior dispatcher

* Operations manager

* Hiring support

* Training support

* Customer service lead

* City launch support

* Admin manager

* Multi-city operations support



We want people who are serious about building a career with us.



As Atlantic Pedicabs maintains stability and expands into other cities, there will be more opportunities for dependable people who prove themselves.



## Important Note About English and Professionalism



Please only apply if you have strong spoken and written English.



This job requires direct communication with customers, riders, and management. If you are not comfortable speaking and writing in English throughout your shift, this will not be the right position.



Please also only apply if you are a serious professional. We are looking for someone who respects time, shows up early, communicates clearly, and takes pride in doing the job correctly.



We respect everyone’s time and ask that you only apply if you truly meet these requirements.



Start Date: Immediate start. We are hiring now and training will begin right away for the right candidate.



## How to Apply



To apply, please start your message with:



**“Boardwalk Operations”**



Then answer the following questions:



1. Why are you interested in this role?

2. Are you available to work 2:00 PM to 12:00 AM Eastern Time, 5 days per week?

3. Are you comfortable working either Monday/Tuesday off or Tuesday/Wednesday off?

4. Describe your spoken and written English level.

5. Tell us about a time you handled an upset customer or a stressful work situation.

6. Do you have any dispatch, customer service, logistics, taxi, delivery, hotel, or operations experience?

7. Are you comfortable learning the Ocean City, Maryland Boardwalk, including hotels, restaurants, attractions, landmarks, and street numbers?

8. What tools or software have you used for work?

9. Do you have reliable internet, a quiet work environment, and a working headset?

10. Are you able to check in a few minutes before every shift?

11. Why should we trust you with a live transportation operation?

12. Are you looking for long-term stable work with room to grow?



Applications that do not start with **“Boardwalk Operations”** may not be reviewed.



We are looking for serious, reliable, long-term candidates only.
