title: Landing Page Copywriter / Web Content Specialist for Industrial Container Products
description:
Job Description:



We are looking for a skilled landing page copywriter / web content specialist who can prepare content for 3 separate product landing pages in Ukrainian.



Important: you do not have to be a native Ukrainian speaker. You may use AI tools, translation tools or professional translation support to prepare the Ukrainian version. However, the final text must be clear, natural, professional and suitable for publication. We will verify the Ukrainian content before publishing.



Our company produces and supplies different types of container-based solutions for business, industrial, construction, logistics and specialist applications. We already have existing Polish websites with product descriptions, photos and company information. Your task will be to understand the current content, select the most important selling points, and transform it into clear, professional and persuasive Ukrainian landing page content.



This is not a simple translation job. We do not want to copy all information from our existing websites. We need concise, sales-oriented landing pages that present the product category, explain the value for the target market, and encourage potential clients, distributors or business partners to send an inquiry.



The project includes 3 landing pages:



1. Custom technical and industrial containers

A landing page presenting our production capabilities. We manufacture technical, industrial and specialist containers on individual order. The goal is to show that we can design and produce containers for many different technical applications, depending on the client’s needs.



Examples of applications include technical containers, industrial containers, energy storage containers, fire protection containers, pump station containers, chemical containers, electrical switchgear containers, server containers, boiler room containers and other custom-made solutions.



2. Flatpack / TRUCKPACK containers for wholesale orders

A landing page presenting flatpack modular containers for self-assembly. The key message is efficient logistics, fast delivery and wholesale cooperation. Up to 10 container modules can be transported on one truck, which significantly reduces transport costs.



Important: this offer is for wholesale / B2B orders only, not for single retail customers.



3. Protective / anti-fragmentation sea container project

A landing page for a new separate brand/project. The product is based on sea containers upgraded with a ballistic / anti-fragmentation protective coating. The containers can be adapted to different practical uses and project requirements.



Important: this page should not mention the name of our material supplier. We are creating a new independent brand for this product.



What we need from you:



* Create Ukrainian landing page copy for each of the 3 product categories.

* You may use AI or translation tools to prepare the Ukrainian content, but the final result must be polished and publication-ready.

* Structure each page as a professional offer page, not as a long technical article.

* Prepare strong headlines, subheadlines, benefit sections, product/application sections and call-to-action texts.

* Adapt the message to B2B clients, construction companies, industrial clients, distributors, public sector buyers or organizations looking for modular infrastructure.

* Make the content clear, trustworthy and focused on generating inquiries.

* Suggest improvements to the page structure if needed.

* Optional but welcome: propose CTA button texts, short form text, SEO title and meta description for each landing page.



You will receive:



* Links to our current websites.

* Product descriptions and reference information.

* Photos / visual materials if needed.

* General direction for each landing page.



Required skills:



* Experience in landing page copywriting.

* Good English or Polish communication.

* Ability to turn technical information into clear business benefits.

* Ability to prepare or coordinate Ukrainian-language content using AI, translation tools or other reliable methods.

* Understanding of B2B, industrial, construction, modular buildings or technical products will be a big advantage.

* Ability to work independently and ask smart questions when something is unclear.



Deliverables:



For each of the 3 landing pages:



1. Page title / main headline

2. Hero section text

3. Short product introduction

4. Key benefits section

5. Applications / use cases section

6. Why work with us section

7. Call-to-action section

8. CTA button text

9. Short contact form intro

10. SEO title and meta description



To apply, please send:



1. A short introduction about your experience.

2. Examples of landing pages, website copy or B2B content you have written.

3. Information on how you would prepare Ukrainian content — for example with AI, translation tools or Ukrainian language support.

4. Your total fixed price for preparing all 3 landing pages.

5. Alternatively, you may provide a separate fixed price for each landing page.

6. Please clearly state whether your price includes research, copywriting, Ukrainian translation/adaptation and revisions.

7. Estimated delivery time.

8. Number of revisions included in your price.



We are looking for someone who can create clear, strong and professional sales content — not just translate words.

title: VSL Video Editor / Designer for DTC Wellness Brand — Hook-Driven Short-Form Ads (Long-Term)
description:
About us



We're a fast-growing direct-to-consumer comfort & wellness brand launching in the UK. We sell a premium weighted comfort plush that helps people relax and sleep better. Video is our main growth engine — and we're building a content machine to grow on TikTok, Instagram, and
.

What we're looking for



A short-form VSL video editor/designer who can turn raw inputs — stock footage, licensed clips, UGC, customer reviews, and brand assets — into scroll-stopping, high-converting video ads built around strong hooks. You'll add voiceovers, captions, sound design, and pacing that keep viewers watching all the way to the CTA.

This is high-volume, fast-turnaround work. We test relentlessly, so we need someone who can produce multiple variations daily and isn't precious about it. You understand that the first 3 seconds d
 everything.

What you'll do



Edit 15–60 second VSLs and UGC-style ads for Meta & TikTok

Source and assemble suitable footage (stock, royalty-free, licensed, UGC, brand-provided) into seamless edits

Add voiceovers (your own, AI like ElevenLabs, or talent we provide), captions, b-roll, music, and sound effects

Build multiple hook variations of the same ad for split-testing

Produce 3–4 videos per day once ramped up

Iterate fast based on performance and feedback

Keep a consistent brand feel: calm, warm, premium — never cheap or childish



Must-haves



Proven experience editing short-form DTC / direct-response ads (portfolio required — show ads that actually ran)

Mastery of CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve

Strong grasp of hooks, retention, and pacing for paid social

Clean, error-free English captions

Fast, reliable, high-volume output

Knows where to source footage safely (no random copyrighted clips that get ad accounts banned)



Nice-to-haves



Voiceover ability

Light hook/copywriting skill

Experience in wellness, sleep, or comfort niches

Familiarity with Meta/TikTok ad policies



How to apply (read carefully — generic applications ignored)



Send your portfolio: 3–5 short-form ads you've edited (ideally ones that ran on paid traffic).

Send us your BEST work — the edits you're most proud of — so we can see exactly what level we'd be working with and what you're capable of.

In one line: what makes a hook stop the scroll?

Start your message with the word "WEIGHTED" so we know you actually read this.

Bonus: send a 15-second sample hook edit using any product you like. Best sample gets hired, even with a thinner portfolio.

title: Technology & Business Coach
description:
*** Please include your resume with the number PH-005 as the subject header, along with outlining your relevant experience and qualifications to be considered for an interview, provide link of your resume and short video introduction. ***



About us: 



At PTOE Global Solutions Inc., we believe that true leadership outpaces and outperforms when it is rooted in deep personal purpose, clear communication, and professional stewardship. We are a premier executive and organizational coaching firm dedicated to unlocking the highest potential of individuals, startups, and established teams. By challenging traditional mindsets and utilizing proprietary growth models, we empower leaders to integrate technical excellence with critical personal values like work-life balance, comradeship, and empathy. 



Our mission is to help our clients build lasting legacies while orchestrating a "harmony over hustle" approach to business. We operate with a collaborative, democratic culture where modern techniques, mindfulness, and strategic innovation meet. If you are passionate about talent development, digital efficiency, and driving high-impact, human-centric transformations, you will find a purpose-driven home with us. 





Role Summary: 



PTOE Global Solutions is looking for a Technology & Business Coach to support business owners, founders, and leadership teams in using technology, systems, and business practices to improve execution, scalability, and sustainable growth. 



This role will work directly with PGS clients, including businesses supported through PGS-managed solutions. The coach will help clients clarify business priorities, identify operational and technology gaps, improve leadership accountability, and connect business goals to practical technology-enabled solutions. 



The ideal candidate is an experienced coach with strong business understanding, technology awareness, and the ability to help leaders turn insight into action. This person must be comfortable coaching small business owners, SaaS founders, and leadership teams while collaborating closely with PGS delivery, technology, operations, and client success teams. 



 

Key Responsibilities: 



1. Business, Leadership & Technology Coaching 



Coach business owners, founders, executives, and leadership teams on business clarity, growth, accountability, decision-making, execution, and technology adoption. 



Help clients identify gaps between their business vision, current operations, technology systems, team capacity, and growth goals. 



Support leaders in moving from reactive day-to-day management to intentional leadership, structured execution, and better use of systems and tools. 



Guide clients through growth, transition, delegation, operational change, digital transformation, and technology-enabled process improvement. 



Use professional coaching practices aligned with ICF standards, including active listening, powerful questioning, confidentiality, ethical practice, and client-led discovery. 



 

2. Strategy-to-Execution Support 



Help clients clarify business goals, technology needs, operational priorities, constraints, risks, and measurable outcomes. 



Translate coaching conversations into clear action items, leadership commitments, system improvement opportunities, and practical next steps. 



Support the development of simple business rhythms, including weekly priorities, leadership check-ins, accountability scorecards, progress reviews, and technology adoption checkpoints. 



Work with PGS delivery teams to ensure client priorities are understood and translated into effective managed business, technology, automation, and operational solutions. 



  

3. Technology Enablement & Business Improvement 



Help clients understand how technology can support business growth, operational stability, customer experience, reporting, and team productivity. 



Identify opportunities to improve workflows, reduce manual work, strengthen systems, automate repeatable tasks, and improve data visibility. 



Support clients in evaluating current tools, platforms, processes, and technology pain points from a business-value perspective. 



Help clients bridge the gap between business requirements and technical execution without needing to act as a developer or technical architect.  



Partner with PGS technology and delivery teams to ensure client technology needs are clearly communicated and aligned to business outcomes. 



 

4. Client Growth & Value Creation 



Identify opportunities to improve client revenue, profitability, team effectiveness, customer experience, technology usage, and operational stability. 



Help clients reduce owner dependency by building stronger systems, processes, leadership habits, and technology-enabled workflows. 



Support clients in becoming more scalable, stable, and ready for future growth, transition, or acquisition readiness. 



Provide insight into where PGS managed solutions can create the most value for the client. 



  



5. Coaching Program Delivery 



Deliver one-on-one coaching sessions, group coaching sessions, workshops, and leadership development sessions. 



Support coaching-based client programs delivered through PGS and its managed client engagements. 



Develop or refine coaching materials, templates, client worksheets, technology readiness tools, reflection exercises, and accountability frameworks. 



Capture coaching notes, progress updates, client commitments, technology improvement needs, and action items in a professional and confidential manner. 



  

6. Internal Collaboration with PGS 



Partner with the Head of Solution Delivery, Client Success, Marketing, Operations, Technology, and Delivery teams. 



Share client insights that help PGS improve service delivery, client outcomes, solution design, and technology implementation. 



Support client onboarding by helping clarify goals, pain points, expectations, business model, current systems, technology gaps, and desired outcomes. 



Contribute to case studies, workshops, thought leadership, and client success stories when appropriate. 



  



Required Qualifications 



ICF credential required or equivalent strongly preferred, such as ACC, PCC, or MCC. 



Minimum 3+ years of experience in business coaching, leadership coaching, executive coaching, technology consulting, business operations, digital transformation, SaaS, or founder support.  



Strong understanding of small business operations, leadership challenges, growth constraints, technology adoption, and execution discipline. 



Experience coaching business owners, entrepreneurs, executives, or leadership teams. 



Ability to connect business goals with practical technology, systems, processes, and automation opportunities. 



Ability to coach with both empathy and directness. 



Strong active listening, facilitation, communication, and questioning skills. 



Ability to help clients clarify goals, identify obstacles, make decisions, and follow through on commitments. 



Comfortable documenting insights, summarizing discussions, and creating practical action plans. 



  

Preferred Qualifications: 



PCC-level ICF credential or active progression toward PCC is preferred. 



Experience working with SaaS businesses, service businesses, managed services, software platforms, app-based businesses, or growing entrepreneurial companies. 



Background in project management, change management, operations, business consulting, client success, technology delivery, or digital transformation. 



Experience with frameworks such as OKRs, EOS, Lean Startup, Agile, Prosci, business model design, accountability scorecards, or technology roadmaps. 



Understanding business valuation, acquisition readiness, owner dependency, succession planning, technology modernization, or business transition is an asset. 



Experience facilitating workshops, leadership offsites, technology discovery sessions, or group coaching sessions. 





Ideal Candidate Profile: 



The ideal candidate is a coach-consultant hybrid with both business and technology fluency. They can create a safe and reflective coaching environment while also helping business owners make practical decisions about growth, systems, processes, and technology. 



They do not need to be a tech person, but they must understand how technology can improve business performance, reduce operational friction, support automation, improve reporting, and help a business scale. 



They should be comfortable working with entrepreneurs who are overwhelmed, stretched, or navigating a new stage of growth. They can respectfully challenge clients, ask powerful questions, and help leaders take ownership of their business, team, systems, and future direction. 



This person should align with PGS’s broader values of Purpose, Value, and Stewardship, helping leaders build businesses that are not only profitable, but sustainable, responsible, systemized, and well-managed. 





Core Soft Skills:  



Strong communication, collaborative leadership style, and the ability to thrive in agile environments. 



 

What we offer: 



Competitive renumeration.  



Flexible work hours & remote options.  



Opportunity to work on multiple exciting projects in a dynamic environment.  



Collaborative and innovative team culture.

title: Growth Hacker - Startup B2B SaaS
description:
# Growth Lead / Growth Hacker for Boost



## About Boost



Boost is building an ecosystem of tools and training for independent restaurants, coffee shops, and foodservice operators.



Boost Back Office is already launched. It helps restaurant owners better understand and manage the operational numbers behind their business, including inventory, COGS, recipe costing, menu profitability, ordering, and related back-office workflows.



Boost Academy is launching soon. It will provide practical, framework-based training for restaurant owners and operators, helping them understand their numbers, improve profitability, and run stronger businesses. Academy will also serve as the top of the funnel for Boost Back Office and, eventually, Boost Front Office.



We are looking for someone who can help turn Boost Academy into a repeatable growth engine.



## Role Overview



We are hiring a Growth Lead / Growth Hacker to own the direction, testing, and execution of our growth strategy across paid ads, organic social, founder-led content, funnels, and conversion paths.



This is not a generic social media role. We need someone who thinks in terms of offers, hooks, CAC, conversion rates, creative testing, funnel leaks, retargeting, and revenue. The goal is not just to post content. The goal is to help us acquire Academy customers, grow the community, and move the right customers into Boost Back Office.



You will work directly with the founder, who will provide the subject-matter expertise, product vision, frameworks, and raw content. You will help turn that into a measurable acquisition system.



## What You’ll Own



* Paid social direction, especially Meta and other channels where restaurant owners can be reached

* Organic social direction across relevant platforms

* Content strategy for founder-led videos, interviews, course clips, and educational content

* Ad creative strategy and creative briefs

* Landing page and funnel improvement recommendations

* Lead magnet, webinar, workshop, and low-ticket offer testing

* Retargeting strategy for viewers, leads, Academy buyers, and Back Office prospects

*
 nurture direction

* Weekly growth reporting

* Identifying what is working, what is not working, and what should be tested next



## You Are a Good Fit If You



* Have experience growing a product, course, SaaS, community, agency, or expert-led business

* Understand paid acquisition and organic content strategy

* Can work with founder-led content and turn expertise into marketable assets

* Think in terms of testing, not guessing

* Can look at a business and quickly identify the highest-leverage growth opportunities

* Are comfortable creating structure in an early-stage environment

* Can manage yourself without constant direction

* Can tell the difference between vanity metrics and actual business growth

* Are willing to challenge weak ideas and explain your reasoning clearly

* Can work with a producer/editor to turn strategy into publishable assets

* Are a self-starter and don't need to rely on me to tell you what to do every day



## What Success Looks Like



Success in this role means we are learning quickly, improving the funnel, and building a repeatable acquisition engine.



Key metrics may include:



* Cost per lead

* Cost per Academy customer

* Academy landing page conversion rate

* Academy revenue from paid and organic channels

*
 opt-in rate

* Academy customer quality

* Academy-to-Back-Office conversion rate

* Back Office demos/trials generated from Academy

* Winning ad angles identified

* Winning content topics identified

* Growth experiments completed per month



## Initial Priorities



In the first 30 days, I would expect you to help with:



* Auditing the current Boost positioning, offers, funnel, and content opportunities

* Recommending the first flagship Academy offer to advertise

* Defining the first 3–5 growth experiments

* Creating the first paid social testing plan

* Creating a simple weekly growth scorecard

* Creating briefs for the producer/editor

* Helping turn founder-led content into ads, social clips,
s, and funnel assets

* Identifying what resources are required before we scale spend



## Time and Work Expectations



I care more about effective output than hours.



That said, any hours billed to Boost must be hours actively worked for Boost. I do not want overlapping billing, double-booked work, or a situation where someone says they are working eight hours for Boost while actually splitting that same block of time across multiple clients or jobs.



I would rather pay more for fewer honest, focused hours than pay for a larger block of time that is not actually dedicated to this business.



Please be clear about your real availability, preferred working arrangement, and how many focused hours per week you can reliably commit.



## To Apply



Please do not send a generic cover letter. Instead, answer the questions below.



1. Describe your biggest career win when it comes to growing a business, course, SaaS product, community, or paid acquisition funnel. Include the starting point, what you did, what changed, and the measurable result.



2. Explain what you would do in week one to get started quickly with Boost. Be specific. I am looking for how you think, prioritize, and create 
ntum.



3. Explain what resources you would need to do this job that you do not have yet. This should not be a wish list, but the true requirements: access, tools, data, assets, budget, people, or information you would need to perform well.



4. Give an example of a time you had to create traction without much direction. What did you do?



5. What growth metrics would you want to see weekly for Academy and Back Office?



6. What would you want the founder to keep owning/doing, and what would you want to take off the founder’s plate?



7. How many focused hours per week can you realistically commit to Boost, and how do you handle time tracking or work logs?



8. Are you currently working with other clients or employers? If so, explain how you avoid overlapping work time and ensure billable hours are dedicated to the client being billed.



9. Share links to relevant examples, case studies, campaigns, funnels, ads, content systems, or growth work you have led.



Applications that show clear thinking, ownership, and specific examples will be prioritized.

 tools or outreach platforms is a plus

Stable full-time hours

A focused, niche company where your work directly impacts growth

title: WordPress FSE Expert Implementation Developer
description:
ABOUT THE WORK

We turn strategy into shipped web properties across a growing portfolio of brands (advisory, education, media, wellness, and client work). This role is about building, not babysitting: standing up new WordPress sites from briefs, extending a shared theme system that powers the whole portfolio, and shipping clean, fast, and on-spec.



You'll work from clear scopes against real deadlines, in a codebase that has opinions. We value developers who take ownership, ask sharp questions early, and ship work that doesn't come back. If you do your best work in a quiet, focused, low-drama environment, you'll fit here.



THE STACK

We build modern block themes. Full Site Editing, theme.json-first styling, block patterns, and template parts. Our brands run on a shared base theme, so a change to the system can ripple across many sites. That means we care more about discipline than plugin count:

- Gutenberg / FSE native. We do NOT use Elementor, Divi, Bricks, or WPBakery, and we're not looking to. If your WordPress is "drag the page builder, install 30 plugins," this isn't for you. We use WordPress FSE best practices across the board. No exceptions.

- Clean cascade, no shortcuts. theme.json and colocated CSS over global stylesheets. No `!important` when a rule doesn't win, you fix the cause (specificity, source order, markup), not paper over it.

- Restraint over abstraction. A pattern, custom block, or template part earns its place by being reused across pages.

- Generic, semantic naming. Classes describe form, not location (card, not teaching-card).

- WP-CLI fluent. Safe search-replace, db, post, cron, cache. You reach for `wp` before raw SQL, and you back up before you mutate.



If that reads as constraints, this isn't your role. If it reads as relief, read on.



WHAT WE BUILD

New sites & funnel-based buildouts (primary)

- Stand up WordPress block-theme sites from briefs, wireframes, or designs - extending the shared base theme rather than reinventing per site

- Build pages with native blocks, patterns, and template parts; write theme.json and colocated CSS, not a pile of plugins

- Implement to spec: accurate, responsive, cross-browser, fast

- Build forms, opt-ins, membership/access-control, and lead flows that work the first time



Integrations & tracking (part of every build, not an afterthought)

- Wire up Fluent CRM, Amazon SES, affiliate/tracking (Everflow), and similar

- Implement and verify GTM, GA4, Meta Pixel, and conversion/event tracking - and confirm the data actually lands

- Connect third-party apps and APIs cleanly when appropriate



Performance & quality (baked in)

- Ship Core Web Vitals–friendly builds: optimized assets, lean plugin footprint, sane caching

- QA across devices and browsers before handoff - no broken links, no console errors, no surprises

- Only write custom PHP / JS / CSS where the build genuinely calls for it



System & maintenance (secondary, but it matters here)

- Extend and harden the shared theme system; keep file-based templates and DB overrides in sync

- Updates, fixes, and small enhancements on properties across the portfolio

- Document what you changed (we keep changelogs and context notes) so the next person picks up cleanly



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Strong, demonstrable WordPress FSE build experience - block themes / FSE specifically, not just maintenance or page-builder work. Live URLs you can point to.

- Real fluency in JavaScript, HTML, PHP, and CSS - you can read and write custom code, and you understand the cascade well enough to win specificity battles without `!important`

- Hands-on with `theme.json`, block patterns, template parts, and WP-CLI

- Comfortable with GTM, GA4, and pixel/conversion tracking

- Performance and SEO-readiness built into how you work, not bolted on at the end

- Self-directed: you run your own task management and communicate cleanly in Slack

- Reliable on deadlines and obsessive about the last 5% - the details that make a build feel finished



Bonus: experience with membership/access-control or building/maintaining a multi-site portfolio on a shared theme.



HOW WE WORK

- Remote and async-friendly; some overlap with US Central hours for syncs when needed

- Day-to-day comms in Slack

- Contract / project-based to start, with steady ongoing work for the right person

- Rate: competitive



HOW TO APPLY

Send:

1. Portfolio - 2–3 WordPress sites you built, with live URLs and one line each on what you actually did. Block-theme/FSE examples get read first.

2. One complex build or integration problem you solved and how you solved it

3. Your availability, timezone, and rate

4. Start your message with the word "Delivery" so we know you read this



Strong candidates will be asked to complete a short, paid test build before we move forward.

title: OPERATIONS MANAGER - Finance, Systems & Scale
description:
OPERATIONS MANAGER



The Nordstick (HepPros LLC) | Remote | Full-Time



ABOUT THE NORDSTICK

The Nordstick is a fast-growing DTC fitness equipment brand built around premium functional products like the NordBench Pro. We have grown 400%+ year over year and are scaling aggressively. Our operation runs on Shopify with a pre-sale model, a manufacturing partner in Hong Kong, and a 3PL network across multiple U.S. warehouse locations.

Operations at The Nordstick is not admin work. It is cash flow management, inventory intelligence, execution speed, and margin protection.

We are looking for an elite Operations Manager who can think like a CFO, execute like an operator, and build systems that scale.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS (AND IS NOT)



This role is not:

--> Updating spreadsheets without context

--> Reacting to problems after they happen

--> Overbuying inventory "just in case"

--> Managing ops without understanding cash flow



This role is:

--> Owning the 13-week cash flow forecast

--> Making inventory decisions tied to demand and capital

--> Using Shopify, data, and AI to stay ahead of issues

--> Coordinating across multiple 3PLs for speed and margin

--> Turning CX signals into product and process improvements

--> Being the connective tissue between our manufacturer in Hong Kong, our 3PL partners, our CS team, and leadership



WHO YOU ARE

You are not just operationally great. You understand money. You know what cash on hand means, why contribution margin matters, and how inventory decisions ripple into the P&L. You have built financial models before, not just maintained them, and you can walk a founder through a cash flow forecast without needing a finance team behind you.



You think in systems. You do not chase fires. You build the infrastructure that prevents them. When something breaks, you fix the root cause, not the symptom.



You are comfortable with AI tools, not just as a user but as a builder. You have used Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools to ship actual working systems, and you can maintain and improve what already exists.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



CASH FLOW AND FINANCIAL PLANNING

--> Build and own a rolling 13-week cash flow model, updated weekly, covering in-stock and pre-sale scenarios

--> Forecast inventory buys, marketing spend impact, loan repayments, and shipping and fulfillment costs

--> Model best-, base-, and worst-case scenarios

--> Model inventory financing decisions: Shopify Capital, working capital loans, supplier payment terms, and loan vs. payback rate tradeoffs

--> Know cash on hand, weekly burn, weekly contribution margin, and profitability to one decimal at all times

--> Ensure The Nordstick stays in stock without overbuying or locking up cash



INVENTORY AND DEMAND FORECASTING

--> Forecast demand using Shopify sales data, growth rates, seasonality, and marketing plans

--> D
 when and how much to reorder to prevent stockouts that kill 
ntum and overstock that traps capital

--> Manage POs from factory confirmation through container receipt, including ETD/ETA tracking and customs clearance via our freight forwarder

--> Track batch-level inventory counts and maintain the allocation sheet as the source of truth for CS order messaging

--> Monitor warehouse storage costs and manage dead inventory decisions in coordination with leadership

WORKING CAPITAL AND GROWTH FINANCING

--> Leverage Shopify Capital, working capital loans, and supplier terms strategically

--> Provide units-on-hand and container count data for leadership's negotiations with the manufacturing partner

--> Participate in tariff strategy decisions with the customs broker, including PSC filings and Section 232 duty refund coordination

--> Balance growth speed with financial safety; capital is used strategically, not emotionally



SHOPIFY AND SYSTEMS OWNERSHIP

--> Be deeply fluent in Shopify Admin: order-level actions, SKU management, fulfillment status, and operational data

--> Own operational data: orders, refunds, shipping costs, and inventory

--> Build and maintain dashboards, Google Sheets models, and custom reports

--> Bonus: ability to build custom dashboards or internal tools using Python, SQL, JavaScript, or Google Apps Script



3PL AND SHIPPING OPTIMIZATION

--> Manage our 3PL relationships across multiple U.S. warehouse locations using ShipHero and ShipStation

--> Maintain FIFO allocation rules across warehouses, manage priority-adjusted orders, and approve or deny partial shipments based on fulfillment logic

--> Manage the warehouse-level approval process for inbound POs, including specifying which SKUs go to which warehouse location based on velocity and buffer strategy

--> Track average shipping cost per unit weekly, by zone, and blended; reduce average shipping zones over time

--> Evaluate per-unit carrier cost tradeoffs for bulk freight and individual shipments

--> Maintain and update landed cost per unit as COGS, freight, and tariff conditions change

--> Escalate and track fulfillment errors through to resolution



CX TO OPS TO PRODUCT FEEDBACK LOOP

--> Work closely with Customer Support to identify repeat product issues, confusion points, and return drivers

--> Maintain the product issue and parts request tracker, categorized by defect type: product defect, instruction failure, info/expectation failure, and missing parts

--> Track issue counts weekly and trend over time to surface whether product changes are reducing complaints

--> Fix problems at the source by recommending improvements to instructional videos, setup guides, and product design

--> Serve as the primary source of truth for CS on shipping timelines by product and order date range



AI AND EFFICIENCY LEVERAGE

--> Work hands-on with agentic AI tools, specifically Claude Code, to build, maintain, and improve internal operational systems

--> Build and maintain existing dashboards and reporting tools; this is not a "use AI to summarize" role, it requires actual implementation work

--> Automate reporting, flag anomalies, and reduce manual work across the ops function

--> Identify new automation opportunities and scope them into working tools, not just proposals

--> Follow the principle: AI handles repetition, humans make decisions



WEEKLY REPORTING

--> Produce a Weekly Ops State of the Union for the CEO covering: North Star KPI movement, inventory health, fulfillment dates, shipping zone breakdown, product issue counts, and 13-week cash runway

--> Coordinate with marketing on customer lists tied to batch ship dates for
 sends

--> Work with finance on PO creation, payment coordination, and Shopify/ShipHero cleanup ahead of incoming shipments



TOOLS YOU WILL USE DAILY

--> Shopify Admin: order-level actions, SKU management, and fulfillment status

--> ShipHero: warehouse inventory management, FIFO allocation, PO tracking, and partial shipment logic

--> ShipStation: individual order shipment management

--> Google Sheets: 13-week cash flow model, ops dashboard, allocation sheet, reshipment tracker, and shipment timeline tracker

--> Slack: cross-functional coordination with CS, marketing, finance, and leadership

--> Asana: task tracking and project management

--> Richpanel: visibility into CS ticket data related to ops issues

--> Freight forwarder portal: freight tracking and customs documentation

--> Triple Whale: awareness of how ops data (COGS, shipping cost) affects profit reporting



NORTH STAR KPIs

You will be evaluated monthly on three metrics:

--> Average Shipping Cost per Unit: direction: down month over month

--> Average Time to Ship to Customer: direction: down month over month

--> Product Reliability Index (product-related issues per 100 orders): direction: down month over month

If two or more are improving, Ops is winning. If one or fewer are improving, we are not. No debate. No overrides.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Must-Haves:

--> Proven experience in DTC or e-commerce operations, ideally with pre-sale or made-to-order inventory models

--> Strong financial literacy: cash flow forecasting, margin analysis, working capital management

--> Advanced Google Sheets skills; ability to build and maintain financial models with real data

--> Shopify fluency: operations, not just navigation

--> Experience managing inventory and fulfillment across multiple 3PLs

--> Hands-on experience with agentic AI tools, specifically Claude Code; you must be able to build with it, not just prompt it

--> Ability to build and maintain internal dashboards and operational reporting tools

--> Systems thinker: you prevent problems, not chase them

--> Strong communicator who proactively loops in CS, marketing, and leadership without being asked

Strong Bonus Points:

--> Built cash flow dashboards and models before; must be able to show samples

--> Experience scaling fast-growing DTC brands

--> AI-assisted coding experience (Python, SQL, JavaScript, or Google Apps Script using tools like Claude Code or Cursor)

--> Experience working with freight forwarders and customs brokers

--> Familiarity with ShipHero or a comparable WMS



HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS

--> In-stock rate without cash strain

--> Clean, accurate cash flow visibility at all times

--> Lower shipping cost per order month over month

--> Fewer CX issues caused by ops failures

--> Faster decisions with less chaos



HOW TO APPLY

Send the following to 

--> Your resume

--> An intro video, under 5 minutes, where you introduce yourself and answer why you believe you are a good fit for this role

--> A link or sample of a cash flow model or financial dashboard you have built and maintained before

--> A Loom or Zoom recording walking us through that sample work



Applications without the sample work and video will not be reviewed.

Today, we manage over 1,000 condominium units and 500+ rental units across 60+ associations, maintaining a 4.9-star Google rating with nearly 1,000 reviews.



Our strength comes from being vertically integrated.



Under one roof, we operate:



• Green Ocean Property Management – Full-service residential property management and HOA/condominium management



• Pro Services Boston – Our in-house maintenance team and licensed general contractor handling repairs, maintenance, landscaping, renovations, and more



When we earn a client's trust, we serve them from start to finish.
